command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLBACKEND=Agg
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.
# MPLBACKEND=Agg because obspy imports matplotlib and there is no display.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
NOK=$(sha256sum -c --ignore-missing pins.sha256 2>/dev/null | grep -c ': OK$')
printf 'pinned_files_verified\t%s\n' "$NOK"
test "$NOK" -eq 3 || { echo "FAIL: verified $NOK pinned files, expected 3"; exit 1; }

echo "== the obspy in the image must be the version the reference was taken from =="
# A reference from another version is a different implementation than the one being checked.
V=$(python3 -c "import obspy; print(obspy.__version__)" 2>&1)
printf 'obspy_running\t%s\n' "$V"
test "$V" = "1.5.1" || { echo "FAIL: image has obspy $V, the staged reference is obspy 1.5.1"; exit 1; }

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cp score.tsv obspy-diag.txt 2>/dev/null
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
